FUNCTION handleSetStockLevel(request):
    // REQ-8-029; preconditions: local persistence and valid JSON request.
    AUTHORIZE admin OR RETURN 401 or 403. REQUIRE application/json OR RETURN 415. VALIDATE product, location, and non-negative quantity OR RETURN 400, 404, or 422.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; create or update the product-location stock level; COMMIT; RETURN 200.
    On a conflict or persistence failure ROLLBACK and RETURN 409, 500, or 503.
